Shiba Token, a Dogecoin clone, has deposited half of its supply into the wallet of Ethereum creator Vitalik Buterin.
The move is an attempt to carry out a coin burn, keeping prices high by removing a portion of the supply from circulation. #shibapup

#SHIBARMY #ShibaSwap #shibapup  Shiba Token: The Copycat Dogecoin Runs Coin Burn On Vitalik Buterin
